title: [Master]-Vendor Order No. exceeds 20-character limit causing error in Intercompany Purchase Invoice
summary: Vendor Order No. field is extended beyond 20-character limit to prevent errors in Intercompany Purchase Invoice operations across all regional versions.
key_points: Increased vendor order number field length beyond 20 characters
Fixes intercompany purchase invoice errors caused by truncated vendor order numbers
Changes applied consistently across all localization layers (W1, BE, CH, ES, FI, IT, NA, NL, NO, RU, APAC)
Test cases updated to validate the extended field length
Affects Purchase Invoice page and intercompany testing logic
